# Konn3ct

> Konn3ct is a digital communications and collaboration platform operated by Newwaves Ecosystem Limited — Connection Freedom by Design for meetings, learning, events, and institutional collaboration.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/): Overview of Konn3ct meetings, features, six freedoms, and segment solutions.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/pricing): Compare Free, Starter, Professional, Business, and Enterprise plans in NGN and USD.
- [Trust & Controls](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/trust): TrustLock controls, host responsibilities, and recording and sharing guidance.
- [Discover Events](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/events): Public events, webinars, and community gatherings hosted on Konn3ct.
- [Customer Support](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/support): Raise a support request, report an issue, or get help joining a meeting.
- [Contact Sales](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/contact-sales): Book a product demo or discuss enterprise and institutional deployment requirements.

## Solutions by Sector

- [Government](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/government): Briefings, inter-agency coordination, and sovereign-oriented deployment options.
- [Associations](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/associations): Member meetings, chapter collaboration, and professional learning pilots.
- [Education](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/education): Live classes, tutorials, and campus community sessions.
- [Faith Communities](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/faith): Teaching, fellowship, and leadership gatherings across locations.
- [Business & Corporates](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/corporates): Team meetings, customer conversations, and enterprise collaboration.
- [Events & Community](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/events-community): Structured online and hybrid gatherings with registration and follow-through.

## Legal & Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/privacy): How Newwaves Ecosystem Limited processes and protects personal information.
- [Terms of Service](https://landing.konn3ct.ng/terms): Service agreement and acceptable use terms for Konn3ct.
